args.title: Launch arguments
args.description: Added to every Cursor Agent start in a tmuxedo pane, in this order.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model Cursor Agent starts with (--model). Empty leaves Cursor's own choice.

force.title: Never ask before commands
force.x-dangerous: Cursor runs commands without asking unless you denied them yourself. Use it only in a place you can throw away.

extras.title: Load tmuxedo extras
extras.description: The tmuxedo skill and the items you enable here. Off starts the agent with only what you set up yourself.

keystroke.title: Answer on-screen questions by typing
keystroke.description: tmuxedo types your answer into the pane when the agent asks on screen.
